name: lorikeet-helpcenter
description: Audits a public help center or knowledge base and returns a 0 to 100 health score with the articles that hold an AI agent back.

interface.shortDescription: Score a help center for AI
interface.longDescription: Audit any public help center or knowledge base in seconds. Give it the address (Zendesk, Intercom or any site with a sitemap.xml) and it reads up to 300 public articles, then returns a 0 to 100 health score with the articles that hold an AI agent back: outdated, near duplicate, thin, unstructured or oversized articles, and wording that promises a human follow-up an AI cannot deliver. It uses the same analysis as the Knowledge Base Evaluator on lorikeet.tools. The articles it reads are not saved.
capabilities: Score a public help center from 0 to 100 and list the outdated, duplicate, thin and badly structured articles.
defaultPrompt: Audit the help center at help.figma.com and tell me what to fix before adding an AI agent.
Is the help center at support.zendesk.com ready for an AI support agent?
Find outdated or duplicate articles in the knowledge base at www.intercom.com/help/en

positive.description: Audit the help center at help.figma.com and tell me what to fix before adding...
positive.prompt: Audit the help center at help.figma.com and tell me what to fix before adding an AI agent.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls helpcenter_audit with help.figma.com. Card titled "Help center health for help.figma.com" with the score out of 100, a verdict pill, article count, an "Issues found" bar list and "Start with:" the biggest issue. Takes up to a minute.

positive.description: Is the help center at support.zendesk.com ready for an AI support agent?
positive.prompt: Is the help center at support.zendesk.com ready for an AI support agent?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls helpcenter_audit with support.zendesk.com. Card with the score, the verdict and the issue bars; the reply explains the biggest issues in plain words.

positive.description: Find outdated or duplicate articles in the knowledge base at www.intercom.com...
positive.prompt: Find outdated or duplicate articles in the knowledge base at www.intercom.com/help/en
positive.expected_behavior: Calls helpcenter_audit. Card shows the Intercom platform, the score, and Outdated and Near duplicates counts among the issue bars.

positive.description: Score our FAQ for AI readiness: https://help.figma.com/hc/en-us
positive.prompt: Score our FAQ for AI readiness: https://help.figma.com/hc/en-us
positive.expected_behavior: Calls helpcenter_audit with the full address. Same card as above (the audit reads the whole help center, not one page).

positive.description: Check how healthy the Zendesk help center at support.zendesk.com is and which...
positive.prompt: Check how healthy the Zendesk help center at support.zendesk.com is and which problems to tackle first.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls helpcenter_audit. Card with the score and issue bars; the reply ranks what to fix first. If the same help center was read 3 times in the last hour, a clear "try again later" message instead.

negative.description: One web page, not a help center.
negative.prompt: Summarise this page for me: https://www.example.com/pricing

negative.description: General advice that needs no audit.
